LanguageData.RavenItem_SevenEmotionsNectar.label: (Raven) Seven-Emotions Nectar
LanguageData.RavenItem_SevenEmotionsNectar.descriptio: A thick nectar collected from the stamens of the Seven-Emotions herb, emitting a sweet, blush-inducing fragrance. Not only is it an ingredient for refining special potions, but burning it directly also releases hallucinogenic pheromone smoke.
